plain_text:
Agnes Moorehead appears in 56 recordings across 6 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1937 to 1974. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Agnes Moorehead most often in The Shadow, Columbia Workshop, Suspense, Inner Sanctum Mysteries, The Mercury Theatre on the Air, and CBS Radio Mystery Theater.

Characters credited here include Margo Lane.
